description:
Check a video created with create_product_video. Free (no credits).

Statuses: "queued" and "processing" mean keep waiting — check again in 15-30 seconds (typical total time 1-3 minutes). "completed" includes video_url, a direct MP4 link valid for one hour (call this tool again for a fresh link). "failed" includes error and refunded (true means the credits were returned to the balance). "expired" means the file was deleted after the retention period.
name: get_video_status
title: Get video status
